_note: Chef Specials, one per day (Nico, 2026-10-17: The Kitchen shows only Chef Specials). Each build's `chef` date is the day it was served; never remove or redate one, since every dated build is the archive. build_data.py adds augment text and icons and writes data.js, chef.js and chefs-special.json.

augment_text.With Haste: Gain Move Speed equal to a share of your Ability Haste.
augment_text.Overloaded: Using another Ability resets the cooldown of the chosen ability.

builds.title: Bloodlust Is Healthcare
builds.tagline: Screams for a living and heals off every crit
builds.why: Tryndamere already crits for free: his Fury raises his crit chance as he fights, and Bloodlust spends it to heal him. Critical Healing lets heals crit for 40% more off that same crit chance, and Circle of Death turns 70% of all his healing and Health Regen into magic damage on the nearest enemy champion, so every Bloodlust is a crit roll that blasts someone. Rite of Ruin adds crit chance on every spell cast and Spirit Visage makes his heals 25% bigger. Bloodlust's heal grows with Ability Power, so the crit carry becomes an AP healer whose heals do the killing.
builds.play: Fill your Fury, then Bloodlust next to the enemy you want hit. Undying Rage keeps you alive long enough to cast it again. Tank It Or Leave It is the flex pick.

builds.title: Tailwind Has No Brakes
builds.tagline: Speed is her only stat and every auto hits harder for it
builds.why: Janna stops shielding for the team and becomes an on-hit carry whose only real stat is Move Speed.
how: Tailwind
Part of her bonus Move Speed becomes magic damage on hit and on Zephyr.
Augments

Tap Dancer adds speed on every attack and Don't Blink turns the speed gap into damage. Sound Barrier gives Move Speed whenever she shields an ally, and Get Excited! doubles her speed after a takedown.
Items
Phantom Dancer, Lich Bane and Swiftness add raw speed, Dead Man's Plate dumps it into her next hit, and Cosmic Drive gives more speed when the on-hit lands.
builds.play: Zephyr the squishiest target and keep attacking. Shield an ally for a burst of speed. The longer the chase, the harder you hit.

builds.title: Brushmaker Is Lowkey Lethal
builds.tagline: Makes a bush, leaves the bush and comes out swinging
builds.why: Ivern grows his own ambush wherever he stands and fights from inside it as an on-hit carry.
how: Brushmaker
Grows brush anywhere, and his attacks hit harder while he stands in it or just left it.
Augments

Nature is Healing heals him every time he enters brush, and Shadow Runner gives speed and stealth when he dashes out. Mercy's Strike and Lil' Extra Help turn each Triggerseed shield into fast, long-range empowered attacks.
Items
Nashor's and Guinsoo's stack on-hit damage, Rabadon's grows it, and Cosmic Drive moves him from hedge to hedge.
builds.play: Grow a brush on top of the fight, shield the closest ally and attack from inside it. When the fight moves, grow another one.

builds.title: Bravado Maxxing
builds.tagline: Every spell gives him two hits and every hit gives the spell back
builds.why: Taric stops tanking and becomes an on-hit caster whose attacks refill his spells.
how: Bravado
After each spell his next two attacks come out fast, deal bonus magic damage and cut his ability cooldowns.
Augments
The Boom and the Bass adds another fast, empowered hit after every spell, Mystic Punch takes more off every cooldown on each hit, Firebrand stacks a burn and Upgrade Sheen supercharges Lich Bane.
Items
Lich Bane procs after every spell, Nashor's and Wit's End add on-hit damage, and Riftmaker and Rabadon's bring the Ability Power.
builds.play: Cast a spell, hit twice, cast again. Never let Bravado sit unused.

builds.title: Concussion Protocol
builds.tagline: Your carries make the hits and Braum gets the comet every fourth one
builds.why: Braum turns his passive into the whole build, stacking it himself and cashing in every stun.
how: Concussive Blows
Four hits from Braum or his allies stun, and every one of those stuns counts as Braum's.
Augments
Each stun drops a Cruelty comet, banks Slap Around Adaptive Force and shields him through Courage of the Colossus, and Impassable adds Aftershock and Glacial Augment.
Items
Guinsoo's phantom hit adds an extra stack, so he stuns in three attacks. Nashor's and Wit's End speed him up and Bandlepipes gives the team Attack Speed on every stun.
builds.play: Tag a target with Winter's Bite and keep attacking with your carries. Swap targets after each stun.

builds.title: Vault Is Free Now
builds.tagline: Every spell resets Vault and every Vault leaves a bomb trail
builds.why: Quinn drops crit for Ability Power and turns Vault into her main attack.
how: Vault
She dashes to a target, knocks them back and slows them.
Augments

Overloaded on Vault resets it whenever she casts another ability. Every Vault is a dash for Earthwake, Cruelty drops a comet where the knock-back ends and Chain Reaction bounces the knock-back into other enemies.
Items
Stormsurge, Rabadon's and Shadowflame make every Vault burst, and Rylai's slows the whole trail.
builds.play: Vault, cast Q, Vault, cast W, Vault. Behind Enemy Lines resets it once more.

builds.title: Spell Thief Flash Era
builds.tagline: Three Flashes, zero plans and every one of them explodes
builds.why: Zoe's Spell Thief hides a second passive line under the one everyone reads: whenever she casts that Ability or any Summoner Spell, she tosses 3 missiles at the target she Attacked most recently. Flashy gives her Flash three charges and Flashbang makes every one of those Flashes explode for damage and a Slow, so a single blink is now an area nuke plus a volley, and Flash 2 hands her a second Flash plus 70 Summoner Haste so the whole bar reloads sooner. Poltergeist bolts on one more Summoner Spell that casts Barrier and Ghost together, so even her panic button is three more missiles. Ionian Boots of Lucidity feed the loop with Summoner Spell Haste, Lich Bane turns the Attack she throws after an Ability into a bonus magic hit while it also marks who the next volley chases, and Rabadon's Deathcap, Shadowflame, Stormsurge and Void Staff make each small magic hit land like a real one. The long-range Paddle Star sniper stops waiting on her star and becomes a machine gun whose trigger is the Summoner bar.
builds.play: Attack whoever you want dead first, because the missiles follow the last target you hit. Then empty the bar on top of them, and Flash sideways, not away.

builds.title: Reckless Swing on Repeat
builds.tagline: Pays in HP and swings again before the bill arrives
builds.why: Olaf pays for every axe in Health, and the lower he goes, the harder and faster he throws.
how: Berserker Rage
Attack Speed for every point of Health he's missing. Reckless Swing costs Health to cast.
Augments

Overloaded on Reckless Swing resets it every time he throws Undertow, so he can keep spending Health. Ominous Pact pays it back as Ability Power, Move Speed and Omnivamp, escAPADe turns that AP into Attack Damage, and Skilled Sniper refunds Undertow on hits beyond 600 range.
Items
Attack Speed from Berserker's, Wit's End and Kraken. Shojin and Hexplate add the damage and the Health he burns.
builds.play: Throw axes from max range, Reckless Swing after every throw, and stay in the bottom third of your Health bar.

builds.title: Joy Unending (Unhinged)
builds.tagline: Her crits heal the team and the whip does the rest
builds.why: Nilah turns into a frontline medic whose auto attacks are the healing spell.
how: Apotheosis
Heals every nearby ally for part of its damage. Formless Blade turns her crit chance into lifesteal.
Augments
Critical Healing lets every heal crit. Spirit Bomb and Empowered By The Faithful fire off each ally heal, and Group Hug, rolled on Apotheosis, spreads it to more allies.
Items
Sword of Blossoming Dawn makes each attack heal the lowest ally. Ardent, Moonstone and Helia reward every heal, and Infinity Edge and Navori keep the crits coming.
builds.play: Stick to your tankiest ally and attack anything in range. Hold Apotheosis for a brawl where the whole team is hurt.

builds.title: Prey Seeker From Orbit
builds.tagline: Pops out of the ground and shells you from across the map
builds.why: Everyone uses Rek'Sai's Burrow to tunnel in and bite, but while burrowed her Q turns into Prey Seeker, a long-range burst of earth that damages and reveals whatever it hits, and most players only use it to poke before diving. Skilled Sniper refunds 80% of its cooldown whenever it lands from over 600 range, so Prey Seeker is nearly always up, which races through Multishot's quest of hitting champions with it for extra missiles, and Spell Split splits each of those missiles in two on hit or at max range. Magic Missile fires three more true-damage missiles at every enemy the ability hits, stronger the farther they travel, so a volley from across the lane rains down on the whole team. Horizon Focus feeds the same loop by revealing every champion you hit from 600 range or more plus the enemies around them, and Rabadon's Deathcap, Shadowflame, Stormsurge and Luden's Echo pile on Ability Power, so a melee jungle diver becomes an AP artillery mage who never comes up for air.
builds.play: Burrow early and stay under, park at max range and keep firing Prey Seeker at anything in sight. Only Unburrow to knock up a diver, then dig back in and keep shelling.

builds.title: Impact Maxxing
builds.tagline: Every spell resets the charge and every wall hit drops a comet
builds.why: Skarner skips every tank item and turns Ixtal's Impact into a wall-stun loop.
how: Ixtal's Impact
He grabs an enemy and carries them, and slamming into a wall stuns them.
Augments

Overloaded on Ixtal's Impact resets it whenever he casts another ability, and Ultimate Awakening resets everything when he ults. Ravenous Bind on the charge damages and heals on every stun, and Cruelty drops a comet on top.
Items
Rylai's, Liandry's, Riftmaker and Rabadon's make each stun hurt, and Cosmic Drive keeps him moving between walls.
builds.play: Charge someone into a wall, cast Q or W, charge the next one.

builds.title: Bladesurge Locked In
builds.tagline: Never autos and never stops dashing
builds.why: Irelia never right-clicks again and becomes an AP caster whose spells are the on-hits.
how: Ionian Fervor
Stacks Attack Speed every time a spell hits, plus bonus on-hit damage at full stacks.
Augments

Ethereal Weapon makes her abilities apply on-hit, so every one triggers Mystic Punch and cuts her cooldowns. Overloaded on Bladesurge resets it whenever she casts another ability, and Archmage refunds part of a random cooldown with every cast.
Items
Nashor's and Wit's End add on-hit damage her spells now deliver. Rabadon's and Riftmaker bring the Ability Power.
builds.play: Mark targets with Flawless Duet or Vanguard's Edge, then chain Bladesurge through them. Forget your attack button exists.

builds.title: Beartrap Nail Gun
builds.tagline: Every hook is a nail and Skaarl did not consent
builds.why: Kled's Violent Tendencies is a side effect most players barely think about: his next attack grants a big burst of Attack Speed for four attacks, then it sits on cooldown. With these augments rolled on Violent Tendencies, Reload makes every on-hit attack during it cut its cooldown, and Mystic Punch cuts all of his ability cooldowns on every on-hit, so the four fast attacks plus every attack in between bring it back far sooner. While it is up, Lil' Extra Help hands Kled bonus Attack Range and even more Attack Speed, and Pin Cushion turns each of those attacks into Nails that pile up damage and then execute. Guinsoo's Rageblade feeds the same loop, because when fully stacked every third attack applies on-hit effects twice, doubling the Reload and Mystic Punch cooldown cuts, while Blade of The Ruined King, Wit's End, Kraken Slayer and Terminus make every nailed attack hurt. The bear-trap brawler turns into a long-range nail gun that lives in Violent Tendencies.
builds.play: Start Violent Tendencies on whoever is closest, stay at max range so the Nails keep stacking, and let Reload and Mystic Punch hand it right back. Save Jousting to get back onto a target whose Nails are about to pop.

builds.title: Tibbers' Babysitter Era
builds.tagline: Childcare by a child with fire included
builds.why: Molten Shield has a target nobody uses: Annie can cast it on an ally, handing them a shield, a burst of Move Speed and thorns that damage anyone who hits them, and Tibbers spawns wearing one too. With Group Hug rolled on Molten Shield, every cast shields two more allies, so one button is three shields, three speed boosts and three sets of thorns. Enchanting Butterflies gathers a Butterfly for every ally she shields, Sonic Boom makes each shield explode for damage and a Slow around that ally, and Sound Barrier hands every shielded teammate Move Speed and Ghost, so the moment Annie damages an enemy all the Butterflies fly out as magic damage. Moonstone Renewer chains each shield to yet another ally for one more Butterfly and boom, Staff of Flowing Water and Ardent Censer pay her and every shielded ally in Ability Power, Haste and Attack Speed, and Shurelya's Battlesong buffs the whole team for another round of booms. The point-and-click burst mage stops casting at enemies and becomes a shield bot whose damage comes out of her teammates.
builds.play: Stand behind the team and cast Molten Shield on whoever is about to get hit, then tag an enemy with Disintegrate or Incinerate to release the Butterflies. Save the Pyromania stun your shield casts build up for Tibbers.

builds.title: Slingshot Era
builds.tagline: Launches 1800 units and the whole runway explodes behind him
builds.why: Zac skips every tank item and becomes an AP artillery shell.
how: Elastic Slingshot
At rank 5 he flies up to 1800 units, just under the 2000 limit where Earthwake stops working.
Augments

Earthwake leaves an exploding trail along the whole flight. Ravenous Bind on Slingshot damages and heals on every knock-up, Cruelty drops a comet where they land and Slime Time keeps throwing out blobs to heal from.
Items
Stormsurge, Rabadon's, Shadowflame and Void Staff turn each landing into burst, and Cosmic Drive gets him back in position.
builds.play: Max E, charge Slingshot from as far away as you can and fly over the enemy team.

builds.title: Burst Fire Veigar
builds.tagline: Every auto is a spell and every spell is a stack
builds.why: Living Battery has a throwaway line everyone ignores: Zeri's Attacks deal magic damage and are treated as Abilities. Phenomenal Evil reads that literally, so every right-click on a champion permanently stacks Ability Power, turning Zeri into a Veigar who farms stacks by auto-attacking. Marksmage closes the loop by making her Attacks deal extra damage based on that Ability Power, so the stacks go straight back into the autos. Twin Fire and Magic Missile both trigger on ability damage, so every auto also sprays missiles, and her long range lets Magic Missile's shots travel far. The items are pure mage items that key off Abilities: Rylai's slows, Liandry's burns and Luden's echoes all fire off her autos, while Rabadon's multiplies the stacks and Nashor's gives the attack speed to cast her 'spell' faster.
builds.play: Build like a mage, play like a marksman: stand at max range and right-click champions nonstop to farm stacks and launch missiles. Take Phenomenal Evil early so the stacks have the whole game to grow.

builds.title: Cocoon Maxxing
builds.tagline: Every spell resets the stun and the sky drops a comet
builds.why: Elise stops assassinating and becomes a Cocoon turret.
how: Cocoon
A long-range stun in human form. Swapping forms counts as casting a spell, so she has more casts than anyone.
Augments

Overloaded on Cocoon resets it whenever she casts another ability, and Echo Cast sends a clone to throw a second Cocoon. Each stun triggers Ravenous Bind for damage and healing and Cruelty for a comet.
Items
Rylai's, Liandry's and Malignance add slows and burns, and Riftmaker heals her through it.
builds.play: Cocoon, cast any spell or swap form, Cocoon again.

builds.title: Serpentine Grace, No Boots
builds.tagline: No boots, no brakes and every dash explodes
builds.why: Cassiopeia's passive, Serpentine Grace, quietly makes every Move Speed bonus bigger on her, and Twin Fang is a 0.75-second cooldown spell she casts nonstop. With Quickstep rolled on Twin Fang, every cast now dashes her toward her cursor, so she lunges at whoever she is biting every 0.75 seconds; Shadow Runner hands out 300 Move Speed after each dash, which her passive inflates and which never expires because the next dash arrives before the 2 seconds are up. Don't Blink turns that speed lead into 1% bonus damage per 10 Move Speed over the target, and her own Miasma slow and ground plus Petrifying Gaze's slow widen the gap, while Earthwake makes every dash leave a trail that detonates after 0.75 seconds, exactly as the next Twin Fang comes off cooldown. Rylai's slows the target on every fang so the gap grows further, and Cosmic Drive, Lich Bane, Stormsurge, Dead Man's Plate and Force of Nature all carry percent Move Speed that her passive multiplies, with Dead Man's Plate blunting slows and Force of Nature keeping her alive in melee. The stationary poison artillery mage becomes a hyper-mobile drifter who runs rings around the enemy, mining the ground behind her with every bite.
builds.play: Poison with Q or W, then hold E and let Quickstep drag you through the target so each dash lays an Earthwake trail and refreshes Shadow Runner. Save R to stun or slow anyone who tries to match your speed.

builds.title: Arise! (The Interns)
builds.tagline: Why fight when the soldiers do it on-hit
builds.why: Azir never swings his own weapon: Arise! says that when he Attacks an enemy near a Sand Soldier, the soldiers stab instead and deal magic damage in a line, so his real reach is wherever his soldiers are standing. Draw Your Sword makes him melee and pays out Attack Damage, Health, Attack Speed, Lifesteal and Move Speed that grow with every point of Attack Range lost, and Azir gives up a huge chunk of range on paper while giving up none in practice, because the soldiers keep stabbing from their own range. Tickle Monster converts all that Attack Damage, which his soldiers never used anyway, into Attack Speed and adds magic damage On-Hit, and Ethereal Weapon makes his Abilities apply On-Hit effects, so every soldier stab carries Tickle Monster plus Nashor's Tooth, Guinsoo's Rageblade, Wit's End, Blade of The Ruined King and Terminus down the whole line. Master of Duality closes the loop: soldier stabs are Ability damage, so they grant Attack Damage, which Tickle Monster turns into more Attack Speed, which means more stabs, which means more Attack Damage. The ranged control mage becomes a melee on-hit bruiser who collects every melee bonus without ever standing within sword's reach of anyone.
builds.play: Drop a soldier between you and the target, right-click, and let the soldiers do the on-hit work; use Shifting Sands only to reposition onto a soldier, never to go in yourself. Your own sword does nothing, so never fight where a soldier isn't.

builds.title: Glacial Storm Overdraft
builds.tagline: Spent all her mana and got paid in shields
builds.why: Glacial Storm is a toggle that bills Anivia Mana every second it stays on, a running cost nobody thinks about beyond turning it off before she runs dry, and this build makes that bill the whole point. Blue Barrier hands her a share of every point of Mana she spends as a Shield for 1.5 seconds, so a storm that drains her every second re-shields her every second, and Overflow doubles all of her Mana costs, which doubles the Mana feeding Blue Barrier from the very same storm while making the storm's damage more effective too. Mighty Shield pays out Adaptive Force whenever she gains a Shield, which the ticking storm re-arms the moment its cooldown ends, and Ocean Soul grants Health and Mana Regen after damaging enemies, which the storm does nonstop, so the doubled drain keeps getting refilled. Rod of Ages gives Mana back when champions hit her and heals her for 25% of the Mana she spends, which Overflow just doubled, Seraph's Embrace and Malignance pile on Mana to burn, Malignance also scorches the ground under everyone her storm hits, and Spirit Visage makes every shield and heal on her 25% bigger. The fragile artillery mage becomes a frontline tank who walks into the enemy team, flips her storm on and simply stands in it, with Rebirth as the backup plan for when the bank finally closes.
builds.play: Build Mana first, then walk into the fight, toggle Glacial Storm on and stay inside it so the drain keeps re-shielding you every second. Only switch the storm off when you are truly out of Mana, and let the egg handle the rest.

builds.title: Spiked Shell Speedrun
builds.tagline: Armordillo found the attack speed button and won't stop pressing it
builds.why: Rammus trades every tank item for Attack Speed and lets his shell do the damage.
how: Spiked Shell
His attacks deal bonus magic damage from his armor, and Defensive Ball Curl makes them stronger.
Augments

After every spell, The Boom and the Bass and Armored Impact empower his next hit. Firebrand stacks a burn on every attack and Mystic Punch cuts his cooldowns, so the spells and empowered hits keep coming.
Items
Guinsoo's, Nashor's, Wit's End and Kraken stack on-hit damage, and Terminus gives armor as he attacks to feed Spiked Shell.
builds.play: Powerball in, Ball Curl, then attack nonstop and cast a spell whenever one comes back.

builds.title: Lightning Rush Speedrun
builds.tagline: Three feet tall and every crit keeps the zoomies going
builds.why: Kennen becomes a zero-AD crit marksman whose Lightning Rush speed never runs out.
how: Lightning Rush
The Attack Speed he gets when it ends lasts a second longer every time he crits, so a Kennen who always crits never slows down.
Augments

Critical Rhythm and Zealot bring the crit chance and more Attack Speed per crit. Tickle Monster turns his Attack Damage into Attack Speed and on-hit magic damage, and Double Tap applies every on-hit twice on a crit.
Items
Nashor's and Wit's End hit twice per crit. Runaan's spreads the doubled on-hits, and Phantom Dancer and Navori fill the crit chance.
builds.play: Open with Lightning Rush, then never stop right-clicking. Weave Q and W between attacks for the stun.

builds.title: Grand Entrance (Encore)
builds.tagline: Every dash leaves a fireworks trail and the clone does it again
builds.why: Rakan stops protecting the carry and becomes an AP dive bomb.
how: Grand Entrance
A dash that ends in a knock-up. Battle Dance is a second dash back to an ally.
Augments

Earthwake leaves an exploding trail on both dashes. Echo Cast on Grand Entrance sends a clone for a second knock-up, Cruelty drops a comet on each one and Prom Queen casts The Quickness for him with a charm sprint.
Items
Stormsurge, Rabadon's, Shadowflame and Lich Bane make every entrance a full combo.
builds.play: Grand Entrance into the team, aim the clone at a second group, then Battle Dance out and do it again.

builds.title: Snowball Barrage Never Ends
builds.tagline: Every snowball is an auto and every spell reloads the barrage
builds.why: Nunu forgets his ult and turns Snowball Barrage into an on-hit machine gun.
how: Snowball Barrage
Three volleys of snowballs, and enemies hit three times get rooted.
Augments

Ethereal Weapon makes every snowball apply on-hit, which triggers Mystic Punch to cut cooldowns. Overloaded on Barrage resets it whenever he casts another ability, and Erosion shreds resistances with every hit.
Items
Nashor's and Wit's End put on-hit damage on every snowball, and Liandry's and Riftmaker add a burn and healing.
builds.play: Throw Barrage, cast Q or W to reset it, throw again. Save R for an escape.

builds.title: Jaws Maxxing
builds.tagline: One ult buys fifteen seconds of nonstop bites and every heal hurts someone
builds.why: Warwick drops Attack Speed for Ability Power and turns Jaws of the Beast into his only attack.
how: Jaws of the Beast
A bite that scales with Ability Power and heals him for part of the damage.
Augments
Ultimate Awakening resets every basic ability when he ults and gives 300 haste for 15 seconds. Archmage and Infinite Recursion keep Q coming, and Circle of Death turns every heal into damage.
Items
Riftmaker, Rabadon's, Shadowflame and Liandry's power up the bite, and Spirit Visage makes each heal, and so each Circle of Death hit, bigger.
builds.play: Infinite Duress onto a target, then spam Q for the next 15 seconds.

builds.title: Pierce on Business
builds.tagline: Made an oath and brought a spear for every word
builds.why: Kalista stops attacking and becomes a Pierce sniper who throws a spear every couple of seconds from beyond 600 range.
how: Pierce
A long-range spear she normally fires once between attack combos, mostly to stack Rend.
Augments

Skilled Sniper refunds 80% of Pierce's cooldown when it hits from over 600 units away. Magic Missile fires 3 true-damage missiles at everything each spear hits. Hextech Soul chains lightning off the spears, and Siphon, rolled on Pierce, heals her for 30% of their damage.
Items

Spear of Shojin and Lucidity add haste and boost her ability damage. Voltaic Cyclosword charges off each spear for current-Health damage, Serylda's slows the low ones, and Axiom Arc and Edge of Night add lethality.
builds.play: Stand at max range and throw Pierce on cooldown. Only hop with Martial Poise to keep the 600-unit gap.

builds.title: Aura Farming
builds.tagline: He sits down. He closes his eyes. The enemy team dies.
builds.why: Master Yi never attacks. He sits in the middle of the enemy team and Meditates until they're gone.
how: Meditate
A self-heal, a channel and damage reduction in one button. Every piece below hooks into one of those.
Augments

Circle of Death turns his healing into damage and Don't Change the Channel shields him every second he sits. Mosh Monster, rolled on Meditate, slows everyone around him, and Overloaded on Meditate resets it every time he casts another ability.
Items
Spirit Visage makes every heal bigger, so every hit gets bigger too. Warmog's, Unending Despair and Jak'Sho keep him seated.
builds.play: Walk into the middle of the fight and press W. Press Q or E to reset it, press W again. Never right-click a champion.

builds.title: Certified Crashout
builds.tagline: Spells are just the warm-up. The real Rumble starts when he's silenced.
builds.why: Rumble overheats on purpose, locks himself out of his spells and punches everyone instead.
how: Overheat
At full Heat Rumble can't cast, but his attacks hit harder and come faster. He's the only champion whose kit pays him for silencing himself.
Augments
Deft and Tap Dancer pile on Attack Speed, Dual Wield fires a second bolt with every attack, and Firebrand stacks a Burn on each one.
Items
Nashor's Tooth, Guinsoo's Rageblade, Wit's End and Terminus are all on-hit, so every punch and every Dual Wield bolt carries them.
builds.play: Spam spells until you Overheat, then walk up and right-click. When it cools down, do it again.

builds.title: Healing The Opps
builds.tagline: Nobody dies on Kindred's watch. Not even the enemy team.
builds.why: Kindred plays full support, drops Lamb's Respite on everyone twice per fight and heals the enemies right along with their own team.
how: Lamb's Respite
No unit inside can die, ally or enemy, and everyone inside heals when it ends. It's the only ult that blesses both teams at once.
Augments

Ultimate Revolution casts it twice and Stuck In Here With Me taunts the enemies so they stay in the zone. Ethereal Weapon makes her abilities apply on-hit, and each on-hit triggers Mystic Punch to cut the cooldowns, R included.
Items
Redemption, Moonstone Renewer and Dawncore are pure support healing. Malignance adds Ultimate Haste, so the zone is up all the time.
builds.play: Wait for a big fight, press R in the middle of all ten champions, then press it again. Nobody leaves, nobody dies, everybody heals.

builds.title: Skibidi Pillar
builds.tagline: Every pillar is a snack. Every snack hits the nearest enemy.
builds.why: Trundle quits being a melee bruiser and plays like a mage: every Pillar of Ice heals him, hurts everything nearby and launches bees, and every heal zaps the closest enemy champion.
how: Pillar of Ice
Knocks back whoever stands on it and slows everyone nearby. It normally deals no damage and never heals.
Augments

Ravenous Bind and Terrain'd, both rolled on Pillar of Ice, make each knock heal Trundle and the pillar hurt everything around it. That damage counts as an ability hit, so BEES!!! keep launching hives off it. Circle of Death turns 70% of every heal and all his Health Regen into magic damage on the nearest enemy champion.
Items

Spirit Visage boosts every heal and Rylai's slows everyone the pillar hurts. Rylai's, Cosmic Drive and Warmog's push his bonus Health past 2,000, so Warmog's regenerates him whenever he goes 8 seconds untouched, and that regen keeps zapping the nearest enemy. Redemption heals him again from far away.
builds.play: Max E first. Drop pillars on the enemy carry, then step back and let the regen do the poking. Never press Q, never right-click.

builds.title: Whimsy Locked In
builds.tagline: One enemy is a squirrel, then the other three, and the fifth one is just watching
builds.why: Lulu stops shielding anyone and presses Whimsy twice a second until the enemy team is a petting zoo.
how: Whimsy
Turns an enemy into a harmless critter for 2 seconds at max rank, on an 18-second cooldown. That long cooldown is the whole trick.
Augments

Overloaded, rolled on Whimsy, resets it every time she casts Glitterlance, Help, Pix! or Wild Growth, and every Whimsy makes Archmage hand 5.4 seconds (30% of its 18) to one of those three. Ultimate Awakening refreshes Q and E and adds 300 haste after each Wild Growth, and Mystic Punch takes 1.25 seconds off everything per attack.
Items
